title: Lead forms
subtitle: Static lead capture forms that post straight to an inbox you own — S3 bucket, Firestore or your webhook service. No server.
emptyHint: Publish a static lead capture form and import its submissions.

builder.defaultSuccess: Thank you! We'll be in touch soon.
builder.deleteConfirmBody: The form definition is removed. An already published page keeps working until you delete it from your hosting; its submissions can no longer be ingested.
builder.name: Name
builder.redirectUrlHint: Optional: a thank-you page instead of the message.
builder.ownerHint: Or let an automation assign them (round robin).
builder.emailHint: Tip: include the email field — submissions are deduplicated on it and the company is found from its domain.
builder.hiddenValuesHint: Values applied to records created from this form (e.g. lead source = Website, lifecycle stage = Lead).
builder.previewEmpty: Add at least one field to see the preview.

inbox.title: Inbox

help.s3: The visitor's browser PUTs one JSON file per submission into a bucket prefix that accepts anonymous writes only. The admin (or `agentcrm forms ingest`) reads, imports and deletes them. Bucket policy and CORS: see INBOX.md.
help.firebase: Submissions are created in the Firestore `inbox` collection ({formId, data, createdAt}); the security rules allow public create only. The admin reads them with your signed-in account.
help.webhook: Submissions are POSTed to a service you own (Formspree, Web3Forms, Make, Zapier, n8n…). They stay there: nothing comes back to the CRM automatically.

inbox.extraHint: Merged into every payload, e.g. {"access_key": "…"} for Web3Forms. Public.

embed.title: Embed code
embed.hint: Paste this snippet in any page of your website (HTML block). It brings its own styles and submits straight to the inbox.
embed.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the text and copy it manually.

inboxPage.auto: Ingest automatically while the admin is open
inboxPage.autoHint: Every 5 minutes, in one tab. The CLI (`agentcrm forms ingest --yes`) can run it from a cron.
inboxPage.emptyHint: New submissions show up here until they are ingested.
inboxPage.skippedTitle: Inboxes not read from this browser
inboxPage.skippedHint: S3 inboxes are read with the hosting (or data) credentials of this browser; Firestore inboxes with your Firebase account.
